name: Monster Girl Quest: NG+ (Ecstasy)
source: This is a NG+ mod with no relation to the one by SpasMaran. In it, Luka is back at the start of the game, retaining both his skills from part 3 and his memories from the end of it. However, everything else he has done appears to have never happened, with characters like Alice not recognizing him. All he can do now is go on the same quest again, to try and achieve his goal again and find out what happened to him. With his knowledge of everything that's happened, he will be able to do things differently this time. Includes a party system, some new fights and several gameplay tweaks.
translation: 这是一款NG+ 模组，与SpasMaran的模组无关。在其中，卢卡回到了游戏的开始，保留了他在第三部分中的技能以及在第三部分中的记忆。然而，他所做的其他一切似乎从未发生过，像爱丽丝这样的人物都没有认出他。他现在能做的就是再次进行同样的探索，再次尝试实现他的目标，并找出他身上发生了什么。凭借他对所发生的一切的了解，这一次他将能够采取不同的做法。包括派对系统、一些新的战斗和一些游戏玩法调整。
